verdict.rationale: Weaviate's docs describe enabling and configuring an official Weaviate MCP server so LLMs and IDE assistants can interact with an instance. A probe confirms a first-party repository at github.com/weaviate/mcp-server-weaviate. Missing for 10: detail on the exposed tools, operations, and setup steps, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting through it.
